title: Buttered Corn on the Cob - Slow and Sensual
body:
Sometimes simple is best. Just corn. Just butter. Just... taking your time. No rush. Let the butter melt slowly.

Ingredients:
- 4 ears fresh corn
- 1/2 cup salted butter softened
- Sea salt
- Fresh cracked pepper

Steps:
1. Boil water with pinch of sugar
2. Add corn, cook 4-5 minutes
3. Remove and rest 1 minute
4. Apply butter generously, slowly
5. Rotate corn, cover every kernel
6. Season with salt and pepper
summary: Sometimes simple is best. Just corn. Just butter. Taking your time.
